articles.title: Turkey's president gifted Carney a revolver at NATO summit. Carney gave him maple syrup
articles.summary: Turkish President Erdoğan gifted NATO leaders including Carney a custom .357 magnum revolver at the Ankara summit, which Carney said was decommissioned and will be sent to a museum.

articles.title: Carney courts Saudi Arabia as U.S.-Iran ceasefire collapses
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney sought to deepen ties with Saudi Arabia while condemning Iranian attacks on Gulf shipping and signalling a pragmatic reset in relations after years of diplomatic estrangement.

articles.title: Carney backs latest U.S. strikes on Iran as Trump slams NATO allies
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney endorsed the latest U.S. strikes on Iran as a justified response to ceasefire violations while speaking at a NATO summit in Turkey.

articles.title: Carney appoints one of his top advisers and a Conservative MP to Senate
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney made his first Senate appointments including longtime Liberal strategist Tim Pitfield and Conservative MP Richard Martel, signalling a shift from former PM Trudeau's nonpartisan approach.

articles.title: Carney hails submarine deal as NATO win, moves to ease South Korea's disappointment
articles.summary: Prime Minister Carney celebrated Canada's submarine partnership with Germany and Norway while also meeting with South Korea's president to reassure them after their bid was not selected.
